tagline: Hear sine, square, and saw. An explorable that fits a phone.
description:
The original Waveforms is a long article. This is the same lesson — displacement, frequency, air molecules, harmonics — as a walk-through you can finish with a thumb.

Tap Hear for a bass tone. Drag amplitude for loudness, frequency for pitch. Watch a square assemble from odd harmonics, and hear it happen. Your place in the guide is saved: close it, open it later, you are still there.

Unofficial port of Waveforms by Josh Comeau. Bugs go to GifOS, not upstream.
